newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products firm except dipping fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firm except dipping fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Tuesday morning with futures strength, except for fuel oil which weakened with low bunker demand, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline barges traded once at $227 fob Rotterdam and were offered at $228 by late morning, $1 a tonne stronger than at Monday's close. Antwerp offers were $1 lower.
Swaps were up more sharply with September eurograde bid at about $200 fob ARA.
Heating oil barges gained by around $1 as September IPE gas oil futures fell. Rotterdam product remained valued at around Sept IPE flat.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded from $94 to $93 fob Rotterdam with
bunker demand remaining fairly low and as one trading house aggressively sold
